name: Haison Shoujo ~Ayashi Madohi no Kago no Sato~
original_name: 廃村少女 ～妖し惑ひの籠の郷～
source:
Hidden in the depths of the mountains lies the legendary Himeyoshi Village.

When Yakumo Itsuki and his female clubmates set out to find it, they expect nothing more than a fun adventure to break up their ordinary lives. Instead, they find themselves trapped in what appears to be the village from the tale—a maze of abandoned houses wrapped in an unnatural mist that prevents escape.

As days unfold in this forsaken settlement, a disturbing transformation begins. Itsuki notices his companions acting strangely, caught up in forbidden pleasures, their moans echoing through the ghostly village. Even he isn't immune to the village's dark influence, as unsettling desires creep into his dreams.

Into this haze of corruption steps Kagome, a mysterious maiden who presents them with a chilling ultimatum: one must stay behind as a sacrifice, or none can leave. Refusing to abandon anyone, Itsuki desperately searches for another way out. 

Nonetheless, their fate hangs by an ever-thinning thread as the village's influence grows. 
Will they break free from the village's corrupting grip, or will their souls be forever claimed by its dark embrace?

[Based on the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/haison/world.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
深山之中，隐藏着传说中的Himeyoshi村。

Yakumo Itsuki和女社团成员出发寻找这个村庄时，本以为只是一次打破平凡日常的趣味冒险。没想到，他们被困在传说中的村庄里——这里仿佛迷宫一般，废弃房屋被诡异的浓雾笼罩，让人无法逃离。

随着日子一天天过去，这片荒村开始发生令人不安的变化。Itsuki发现同伴们举止反常，沉溺于禁忌的欢愉，呻吟声在阴森的村落中回荡。他也未能免受村庄黑暗力量的影响，令人不安的欲望逐渐潜入梦中。

这片堕落的迷雾中出现了一位神秘少女Kagome，她给众人下达了令人不寒而栗的最后通牒：必须有人留下作祭品，否则谁也不能离开。Itsuki不愿抛下任何人，于是拼命寻找其他出路。

然而，随着村庄的影响不断加深，他们的命运也愈发岌岌可危。
他们能否挣脱村庄腐化人心的束缚，还是灵魂将永远被黑暗吞噬？
